applies_to: Accuenergy Acuvim 3 series multifunction power quality meters, with optional I/O modules.
summary: The Acuvim 3 exposes 2,164 read-only Analog Inputs and 76 Binary Inputs, the same on BACnet IP and BACnet MS/TP: real-time values, sequence components, THD and individual harmonics (magnitude and angle), flicker, demand by quadrant and direction, accumulated energy, and I/O module counters, analog values and DI / relay status.
notes: I/O module objects (DI counters, DI status, AI, AO, relay status) only carry data when that module (IO01, IO11-IO14, IO21-IO24, IO31-IO34) is fitted.
COV increment is supported on BACnet IP only; the default COV increment is 0 on every AI.
The spreadsheet's notes sheet names the firmware 'Acuvim-S v1.04p13'; the title says Acuvim-3.
Source: Accuenergy 'BACnet Points List Acuvim-3' spreadsheet, firmware v1.04p13, generated 2026-10-06.

integration.summary: All objects are read-only measurements. Map system power, energy, demand, PF, current and voltage; most of the 2,240 objects are harmonics and only needed for power quality work.
setup: BACnet IP and BACnet MS/TP expose the same object set.
gotchas: About 1,780 objects are individual harmonic values; don't poll them all on a slow MS/TP trunk.
Set a COV increment before subscribing; the default of 0 reports every change (IP only).
